claim: NVIDIA's official Linux guidance replaces the NVIDIA App GUI with environment variables: PROTON_ENABLE_NGX_UPDATER=1 for DLSS library updates, DXVK_NVAPI_DRS_NGX_DLSS_*_OVERRIDE=on for DLSS overrides, NVPRESENT_ENABLE_SMOOTH_MOTION=1 for Smooth Motion, DXVK_NVAPI_VKREFLEX=1 for Reflex on Vulkan.
quote: Proton must expose NVIDIA's APIs (NVAPI) for DLSS to function. This is done automatically with the included DXVK-NVAPI.

claim: The Proton bug for Age of Wonders: Planetfall — 'Failed to install Paradox Launcher: exit status 1603' — has been open since 6 Aug 2019 and is still unresolved.

claim: Under Proton the usual '<path to exe> %command%' launcher bypass fails; the working pattern rewrites Proton's own command line with sed, e.g. eval $( echo "%command%" | sed -E "s#Launcher/dowser.exe#Cities2.exe#g" ).
quote: The usual method of skipping the Paradox Launcher we know from Cities: Skylines 1 and other Paradox games - putting "<path to executable> %command%" in the launch options - doesn't work with Proton. You can use this command instead: eval $( echo "%command%" | sed -E "s#Launcher/dowser.exe#Cities2.exe#g" )

claim: Heroic Games Launcher is a native client for the Epic, GOG and Amazon Prime libraries on Linux, Windows, macOS and Steam Deck, with built-in download and management of Wine-GE, Wine-Lutris and Proton-GE.
quote: Download and manage the best compatibility tools right from Heroic: Wine-GE, Wine-Lutris and Proton-GE on Linux, or Wine-Crossover, Wine-Staging and the Game Porting Toolkit on macOS.

quote: Compatibility tool for Steam Play based on Wine and additional components

claim: NVIDIA ships Linux and Windows drivers as paired branches — release notes are titled 'Version 595.71.05(Linux)/596.36(Windows)' — so a Windows 596.x install maps to the Linux 595.x branch.
quote: Version 595.71.05(Linux)/596.36(Windows)

claim: From driver 590 (Arch news, 20 Dec 2025) NVIDIA dropped Pascal and older GPUs, and Turing and newer automatically move to the open kernel modules on upgrade; Pascal owners must move to nvidia-580xx-dkms.
quote: With the update to driver version 590, the NVIDIA driver no longer supports Pascal (GTX 10xx) GPUs or older. ... Users with Turing (20xx and GTX 1650 series) and newer GPUs will automatically transition to the open kernel modules on upgrade.

claim: MangoHud is the Vulkan/OpenGL overlay for FPS, frame times, temperatures and CPU/GPU load on Linux — the FrameView/Game Bar performance-overlay replacement.
quote: A Vulkan and OpenGL overlay for monitoring FPS, temperatures, CPU/GPU load and more.

claim: PhysX is a cross-platform SDK that already targets Linux and has been open source under a 3-clause BSD licence since 3 December 2018, so there is no Windows-style redistributable to reinstall.
quote: On December 3, 2018, PhysX was made open source under a 3-clause BSD license, but this change applied only to computer and mobile platforms.

claim: NVIDIA 595.58.03 became the recommended stable Linux driver on 24 Mar 2026; it fixes a kwin_wayland display-wake bug, kernel crashes on DisplayPort MST dock disconnect, and improves system-memory fallback to prevent Wayland desktop freezes when VRAM runs low. nvidia-settings is the Linux control panel.
quote: A big day for NVIDIA GPU owners on Linux, as the brand new 595.58.03 driver is out as the latest recommended stable release with new features. ... Improved support for falling back to system memory when available video memory is low, to help prevent Wayland desktop freezes.

claim: GPU Screen Recorder is the direct ShadowPlay/Instant Replay replacement on Linux, using NVENC and keeping only the last few minutes in a replay buffer.
quote: gpu-screen-recorder can be used for recording your desktop offline, for live streaming and for nvidia shadowplay-like instant replay, where only the last few minutes are saved.

claim: Xbox Cloud Gaming in a browser is officially supported on Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome and Safari — both Edge and Chrome ship for Linux, so cloud streaming survives the migration even though the Xbox PC app does not.
quote: If playing on xbox.com, supported browsers include Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, or Safari.

claim: Discord stable shipped full screen-sharing with audio on Linux/Wayland on 15 Jan 2025, but only for apps routed through PulseAudio and not in the Flathub build at the time.
quote: Finally, Discord stable has a new release available, and it officially brings full screen-sharing with audio on Linux with Wayland. ... it only works if the application you're using goes through PulseAudio. If the app has been updated to go direct to PipeWire it may not work yet.

claim: Vesktop is a third-party Discord desktop client whose headline feature is Linux screen-share with sound on Wayland.
quote: Linux Screenshare with sound & wayland

claim: Epic added Easy Anti-Cheat support for Linux, macOS and Steam Deck including the Wine and Proton compatibility layers, activated by the developer in the Epic Online Services Developer Portal.
quote: Developers can activate anti-cheat support for Linux via Wine or Proton with just a few clicks in the Epic Online Services Developer Portal.

claim: Epic's developer docs require EOS SDK 1.14 or greater and an activated Linux client module; players on Wine or Proton use that Linux client module, so it must be tested and kept current alongside Windows.
quote: To enable support for your game, you must be using SDK version 1.14 or greater and activate a client module for the Linux platform. Players running the game using Wine or Proton will use the Linux client module.

claim: BattlEye works with Valve to enable Linux/Proton compatibility on the same developer opt-in model as Easy Anti-Cheat.
quote: BattlEye To Support Valve's Steam Deck / Proton

claim: Lutris is a game preservation platform covering Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG and Humble Bundle plus emulator and Wine runners.
quote: a video game preservation platform aiming to keep your video game collection up and running for the years to come

claim: Bottles is a general-purpose Wine prefix manager for running Windows software on Linux, not an Epic library client.
quote: Run Windows Software on Linux

claim: Legendary is the free CLI/library alternative to the Epic Games Launcher and is the Epic backend Heroic wraps.
quote: Legendary - A free and open-source replacement for the Epic Games Launcher

claim: Arch Linux's main NVIDIA driver packages now build the open kernel modules by default, mirroring NVIDIA's own upstream default.
quote: Arch Linux's Main NVIDIA Driver Packages Now Using The Open Kernel Modules

claim: The R595 branch (595.45.04 beta, 9 Mar 2026) brings Vulkan improvements, HDR enhancements and DRI3 v1.2, and benchmarked as an incremental gain over 590.48.01 stable on RTX 50 Blackwell hardware.
quote: Vulkan driver improvements, HDR enhancements, DRI3 v1.2 support, and a variety of other improvements ... nice incremental performance improvements over the current NVIDIA 590 driver stable series

claim: NVIDIA raised the minimum supported Wayland version to 1.20 and improved Vulkan swapchain re-creation performance, which is the stutter seen when resizing Vulkan windows.
quote: improved the performance for re-creating Vulkan swapchains

claim: PRIME render offload runs a chosen application on the NVIDIA dGPU while the iGPU drives the screen; Vulkan needs __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1, OpenGL/GLX additionally needs __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia.
quote: __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1 __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia glxgears

claim: NVIDIA proposed a new DRM-KMS-based user-space API for dynamic MUX switching because vga-switcheroo cannot express Advanced Optimus; it is still a proposal, not shipped kernel functionality.
quote: NVIDIA Proposing New Linux API For Dynamic Mux Switching With Modern Dual-GPU Laptops

claim: Advanced Optimus / automatic MUX switching does not exist on Linux; vga-switcheroo is not built for it, so the panel routing must be chosen in the laptop BIOS.
quote: vga-switcheroo isn't cut out for dynamic MUX switching also known as Advanced Optimus

claim: KDE Plasma 6.8 re-enables triple buffering by default for NVIDIA GPUs after the earlier bugs were resolved, reducing visible stutter when the compositor cannot align frame delivery with the display.
quote: Triple buffering reduces visible stutter when the compositor struggles to align frame delivery with the display, noticeably improving daily desktop performance, especially on NVIDIA systems.

claim: DXVK-NVAPI is the NVAPI translation layer Proton ships; DXVK_NVAPI_DRS_SETTINGS and per-setting DXVK_NVAPI_DRS_NGX_* variables expose driver-level DLSS/Frame-Generation overrides, and DLSS requires an NVIDIA Turing-or-newer GPU on the proprietary driver.
quote: DXVK_NVAPI_DRS_SETTINGS allows providing custom values for arbitrary driver settings ... each supported named setting can also be configured with a dedicated environment variable, the name of which is constructed by prefixing setting name with DXVK_NVAPI_DRS_, for example DXVK_NVAPI_DRS_NGX_DLSS_FG_OVERRIDE=on

claim: DXVK-NVAPI 0.9.2 adds limited/incomplete Dynamic Multi-Frame Generation support and picks up the new DLSS driver settings exposed by NVAPI in R595 driver builds.
quote: implements more NVAPI entrypoints for limited/incomplete Dynamic Multi-Frame Generation support

claim: Gamescope is Valve's nested micro-compositor, used on desktop Linux to give a single game its own HDR, VRR and frame-limiting environment regardless of what the host session supports.
quote: SteamOS session compositing window manager

claim: OBS Studio covers the streaming/manual-capture half of ShadowPlay on Linux, with NVENC encoding and a replay buffer.
quote: OBS Studio - Free and open source software for live streaming and screen recording
